description: Fetch NIH iCite citation metrics for PubMed articles: the Relative Citation Ratio (RCR), NIH percentile, citation count, citations per year, expected and field citation rates, the Approximate Potential to Translate (APT), the human, animal, and molecular/cellular shares of each article's MeSH terms, and how many clinical articles cite it. RCR is a field- and year-normalized citation rate benchmarked to NIH-funded papers, whose median RCR is 1.0; iCite computes none for the most recent papers and marks recent ones provisional. iCite does not flag retractions — a retracted article keeps its metrics — so check pubmed_fetch_articles for retraction notices before relying on a record. Up to 1000 PMIDs per call; the first 200 distinct PMIDs are fetched and the rest returned in `overLimit`. PMIDs iCite has no record for are listed in `unavailablePmids`.

pmids.description: PubMed IDs to look up (e.g. ["23456789"]). The first 200 distinct PMIDs are fetched; the rest are returned in `overLimit`. Leading zeros are ignored, so "00023456789" and "23456789" name one article.

name: pubmed_fetch_citation_metrics

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `icite_unreachable`: NIH iCite failed on every attempt the retry budget allowed — a network failure or an HTTP 5xx. `icite_invalid_response`: NIH iCite returned a body that is not its JSON record list on the last attempt the retry budget allowed, or a record for a PMID the call did not request. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Names the PMIDs iCite had no record for, records not yet scored, records with no RCR or a provisional one, and PMIDs past the per-call limit with how to fetch them. Absent when every record came back final and complete.

overLimit.description: PMIDs the call named past the per-call fetch limit. Present only when the call named more distinct PMIDs than one call fetches.

limit.description: Distinct PMIDs one call fetches. The first this many, in request order, were fetched; the PMIDs below were not.

pmids.description: PMIDs past the per-call limit, none of them fetched, in request order — each listed once, under the first spelling sent. Re-call `pubmed_fetch_citation_metrics` with these as `pmids`, at most `limit` per call.

records.description: One record per fetched PMID iCite knows, in request order.

items.description: NIH iCite citation metrics for one PubMed article

animal.description: Share (0–1) of the article's MeSH terms in the Animal category.

apt.description: Approximate Potential to Translate: iCite's estimate of the likelihood that a clinical article will cite this one, reported as 0.05, 0.25, 0.75, or 0.95.

citationCount.description: Citations iCite counts for the article. Absent when the record is not yet scored.

citationsPerYear.description: Citations per year since publication, the numerator of the RCR.

citedByClinicalArticle.description: Whether at least one clinical article cites this one.

clinicalCitationCount.description: Clinical articles citing this one: 0 when `citedByClinicalArticle` is false, absent when that flag is.

expectedCitationsPerYear.description: Citations per year expected for an article in this one's field and year, the denominator of the RCR.

fieldCitationRate.description: Citation rate of the article's co-citation network — the field benchmark the expected rate is derived from.

human.description: Share (0–1) of the article's MeSH terms in the Human category.

isClinical.description: Whether iCite classes the article as clinical research.

isResearchArticle.description: Whether iCite classes the record as a primary research article; reviews, editorials, letters, and errata are not.

journal.description: Journal abbreviation as iCite reports it.

molecularCellular.description: Share (0–1) of the article's MeSH terms in the Molecular/Cellular category.

nihPercentile.description: Percentile (0–100) of the article's RCR among NIH-funded papers. Absent when iCite reports none, as for papers before 1980 and for most-recent-year provisional RCRs.

rcrProvisional.description: True when iCite marks the RCR provisional: a recent paper whose RCR can change as citations accrue. Present only beside `relativeCitationRatio`.

relativeCitationRatio.description: Relative Citation Ratio (RCR): the article's citations per year divided by the citations per year expected for its field, benchmarked so the median NIH-funded paper of the same year scores 1.0. Absent when iCite computes none — papers too recent to benchmark, and some older records.

title.description: Article title as display-ready plain text — markup stripped and HTML entities decoded. Absent when iCite carries none.

year.description: iCite's publication year: the year of the published version, which can differ from PubMed's publication date.

unavailablePmids.description: Requested PMIDs within the per-call limit that NIH iCite has no record for, in request order, under the spelling sent. iCite omits a PMID it has no record for without an error, so the absence says nothing about whether PubMed has the article; pubmed_fetch_articles confirms that.

title: Pubmed Fetch Citation Metrics
